action_scope: Exact qualified qemu-img --help and one read of a fresh2048-byte synthetic raw file into a fresh512-byte output. Existing disk images are not opened. No guest VM, mount, replay, repair, fsck or acceptance change.
resolved_review_finding: Initial unexecuted candidate could omit a spawned child row if the final bounded reap raised. Final source records row/reaped=false/cleanup_error unconditionally and keeps the probe INCOMPLETE.
limitations: Only a passing actual physical capability result can bind the subsequent disk-header reader.
A process stuck in uninterruptible kernel I/O cannot be guaranteed reaped by any finite timeout; this probe records cleanup failure and refuses success rather than hiding the child.
The probe creates its own diagnostic evidence files only; it does not establish saved-disk header values.
